rows.grounds: present passive participle indicating the act of being cut
optative expressing the potential or actual effect of cutting
compound describing one who has reached or is absorbed in that state
compound describing one whose mind is directed toward that

items.question: Can a person absorbed in that state be harmed when subjected to cutting?
premises: A person may be subjected to the act of being cut.
A person can be absorbed in that state with mind fixed on it.
Absorption in that state prevents the effect of being cut.
items.inference: One whose mind is absorbed in that state remains unharmed even while being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Even while being cut, one who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not cut.
